title: Advanced Biology Midterm Review
description: A comprehensive assessment covering cellular biology, genetics, ecology, and metabolic pathways featuring situational analysis and mathematical expressions.

questions.questionText: In a population under Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium, the frequency of the recessive allele is represented by $q = 0.3$. What is the expected frequency of the heterozygous genotype ($2pq$)?

A patient is admitted to the hospital with a severe fever reaching $41^\circ\text{C}$ ($105.8^\circ\text{F}$). At the molecular level, what is the most immediate risk to the patient's metabolic processes?

options.text: The activation energy ($\Delta G^\ddagger$) of all metabolic reactions will drop to zero.
Essential metabolic enzymes will lose their tertiary structure and denature.
Cell membranes will freeze and become completely impermeable.
Glycolysis will rapidly reverse and produce excess glucose molecules.

questions.questionText: Enzymes catalyze biochemical reactions by increasing the total Gibbs free energy change ($\Delta G$) of the system.
The cellular process by which a cell engulfs large, solid particles or whole cells using its membrane is known as _____.
Based on the tracking data provided in the table below, how many net molecules of $ATP$ are produced directly in the cytoplasm from the breakdown of one single molecule of glucose?

A plant cell with an internal water potential of $\Psi = -0.3\text{ MPa}$ is placed in a beaker containing a sucrose solution with a water potential of $\Psi = -0.8\text{ MPa}$. Which of the following describes the net movement of water?

options.text: Water will move out of the cell, causing plasmolysis.
Water will move into the cell, causing it to lyse.
There will be no net movement of water because the system is at equilibrium.
Sucrose molecules will actively pump into the cell until $\Psi = 0$.

questions.questionText: Semi-conservative DNA replication occurs during the $G_2$ phase of the eukaryotic cell cycle.
The primary photosynthetic pigment located within the thylakoid membranes that absorbs blue-violet and red light is _____.
Consider a model cell shaped like a perfect cube where the side length is $s = 2\text{ }\mu\text{m}$. Calculate its surface area-to-volume ratio ($SA:V$).
An agricultural ecosystem experiences heavy fertilizer runoff into a local freshwater lake. What is the most likely long-term situational outcome for the fish population in that lake ecosystem?

options.text: Fish populations will increase exponentially due to an abundance of chemical nutrients.
Algal blooms will consume oxygen during decomposition, causing mass fish suffocation.
The water will become a hypotonic solution, causing the fish cells to shrivel.
The rate of carbon fixation ($CO_2$) by the fish will double.

questions.questionText: The metabolic reactions of the citric acid cycle (Krebs cycle) take place within the inner mitochondrial membrane.
The specialized, functional unit of the human kidney responsible for blood filtration and urine concentration is the _____.
If a sample of double-stranded DNA is analyzed and found to contain $30\%$ adenine ($A$), what percentage of the nitrogenous bases in this sample must be guanine ($G$)?

A laboratory mutation alters a codon sequence in an mRNA strand from 5'-AUG-3' to 5'-AUC-3'. Given that 5'-AUG-3' specifies Methionine (the start signal) and 5'-AUC-3' specifies Isoleucine, what type of point mutation has occurred?
According to the $10\%$ ecological rule of energy transfer, approximately $90\%$ of the energy at any trophic level is lost as metabolic heat or undigested waste.
The biological mechanism by which an organism maintains a stable internal environment despite fluctuating external factors is called _____.

A patient requires an emergency packed red blood cell transfusion. Based on the immunological interaction matrix provided below, which blood type can safely be administered to a patient with Type O blood?

options.text: Any type (A, B, AB, or O)

questions.questionText: An experimental cancer drug is designed to completely prevent the polymerization of spindle microfilaments and microtubules. If applied to a culture of dividing mammalian cells, which phase of mitosis will be directly halted?
Anaerobic respiration (fermentation) produces a higher net yield of $ATP$ per molecule of glucose than aerobic cellular respiration.
The gaseous phytohormone responsible for stimulating fruit ripening and promoting leaf abscission is _____.

An isolated terrestrial ecosystem receives a net primary productivity of $10,000\text{ kcal/m}^2/\text{year}$ at the primary producer level. Following Lindeman's law of trophic efficiency ($10\%$ transfer), how much energy is available to secondary consumers?

You are tracking the growth of a bacterial population in a batch culture setup with limited nutrient supplies. Over time, the exponential phase ends and the growth curve flattens out into a plateau. This stabilization signifies that the population has reached its _____.
Translation is the specific molecular process where an RNA nucleotide sequence is synthesized directly from a template strand of DNA.
The specialized epidermal cell type that controls the opening and closing of stomatal pores to regulate plant transpiration is the _____ cell.

Using the comparative cell division matrix below, determine the final chromosome count in a human daughter cell produced via Meiosis if the starting somatic parent cell has a diploid count of $2n = 46$.
